subject.why: Matches the requested paperboy bike, basket, bell, and fence.

category.why: The fence spans the midground instead of keeping the setting to a simple bottom strip.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: Bike is centered with clear margins and rests properly on the bottom edge.

colour.why: Vibrant, warm palette with good separation from the sky.

detail.why: Forms are chunky and simplified without excessive micro-textures.

style.why: Consistent 3D rendered look with soft shading and satin sheen.

fix: Lower or reduce the fence so only a ground strip remains, opening up the sky and horizon.
